2105-5223-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5223-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5223-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

391-2645-3430-3756.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3430-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3678-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3678-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-1659-2841-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-1659-2841-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

862-4053-6989-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

6006-6633-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-6633-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-6633-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1456-1987-4423-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1456-1987-4423-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

3497-6072-7182.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 4 life this turn.
3497-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2510-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2510-3165-3532-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5295-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3899-4324-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3991-4050-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

454-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
454-2743-4483.description:
Cast Phyrexian Scriptures by paying {2}{B}{B}. When it enters, its first chapter ability triggers, causing Biovisionary to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2034-2423-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bounding Krasis token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1365-2034-2608-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Repeat.
1365-2034-2608-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-2921-4766-5222.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender and Sword of the Realms attached to the same nontoken creature you control.
1069-2921-4766-5222.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with Sword of the Realms and Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature that has Deathrender attached.
Repeat.

requires.n: Equipment That Gives Haste to a Creature

1550-4251-6233--78.notablePrerequisites: Godo cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-6233--78.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ardenn triggers, attaching the Equipment that grants haste and Sword of Hearth and Home to Godo.
Declare Godo as an attacker.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4050-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1270-4050-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping two Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2584-4245.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vrondiss indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Vrondiss.
2584-4245.description:
Give Vrondiss indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss triggers, creating a 5/4 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing five damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss and the Dragon token trigger.
Resolve the Dragon's trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Resolve the Vrondiss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

2233-2899-3569.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-2899-3569.description:
Cast Pollenbright Druid by paying {G}.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Pollenbright Druid's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1170-3368.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1170-3368.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting that spell.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of the instant or sorcery spell and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-4813.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
4499-4813.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Famished Foragers.
Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2367-3000-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create a 1/1 Servo and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
